archetypes.title: Context Distractor Hijacking & Attention Dispersion
archetypes.description: Injected irrelevant telemetry logs or unrelated technical documentation act as attention sinks. High-frequency technical jargon and numeric tokens in the distractor disperse cross-attention weights, causing retrieval poisoning or claim leakage into the generated answer.

archetypes.title: Temporal Precedence & Version Blindness
